entities.name: FtsH-family protease (query)
observations: 626-aa sequence has Pfam AAA ATPase domain (PF00004; aa 181–314), AAA lid (PF17862; aa 341–380), and Peptidase_M41 (PF01434; aa 396–578).
Best reported reviewed homologs are FtsH ATP-dependent zinc metalloproteases: 64.2% identity over 81.3% query coverage (D0MGU8) and 55.6% over 92.3% coverage (A6LD25).
Likely ATP-dependent, zinc-dependent processive protease involved in proteolysis and protein quality control; these are homolog-based inferences, not direct experiments on the query.

A hydrophobic segment at approximately aa 100–120 is consistent with membrane anchoring; homolog references include bacterial inner-membrane and mitochondrial FtsH proteins, so exact query localization is unresolved.
Likely related processes include protein catabolism, proteolysis, and integral-membrane protein quality control; specific substrates and organism-specific roles are not established.
